title: Questions open in a full-screen answer sheet after the item is spoken

requirements.text: An item's question and answer buttons are not shown while the item is being spoken
requirements.check: eye: TJ sees no question on the main panel while an item with a question is read aloud

requirements.text: When the item finishes speaking, a full-screen modal opens with the question, its answer buttons, a text box and a talk-to-answer option
requirements.check: eye: TJ answers one question by button, one by typing and one by voice from the modal

requirements.text: The main walk-through panel no longer has the question built into it
requirements.check: eye: the main panel shows no question area

text: Question removed from Focus and WalkBar; Walker.asking opens AnswerSheet.kt (full screen Dialog) after the item is read: options, type (stops mic), talk (mic), Hear again, Skip, close=pause.
